name: perseus-parallel
description: Greek-English parallel texts aligned by Perseus citation: the Greek historians (Herodotus, Thucydides, Pausanias 1-5, Xenophon's Anabasis, Hellenica and Cyropaedia, Diogenes Laertius) section by section, and the New Testament (Westcott and Hort with the World English Bible) verse by verse; cleaned, split by held-out books, for training translation models.

source.name: Perseus Digital Library, canonical-greekLit, TEI XML
source.files: sources.json (path and SHA-256 of each source file, verified by clean.py)
source.license: Perseus's TEI texts are released under CC BY-SA 4.0; the adapted texts are released under the same licence (LICENSE-TEXT.md, with the copyright check per volume: Pausanias's translation is public domain in the United States but not in countries with terms of life plus 70 years until the end of 2033 and 2034).

format: JSON Lines, UTF-8: one pair a line, {work, ref, split, grc, eng}, in text order
